solar_model.reference_system_note: Target pvgis_pv_power_kw is simulated AC output estimated by EC PVGIS v5.3 (PVGIS-SARAH3 / ERA5) for a reference 15.0 kWp South-facing (31 deg tilt, 0 deg azimuth, 14% system loss) array at Settat. It is NOT metered output from the future EcoFarm plant.

excluded_features_reason.pvgis_sun_elevation_deg: Excluded to avoid redundant collinearity with irradiance and cyclical solar time.
excluded_features_reason.pvgis_ambient_temp_c: Excluded because ERA5 meteo_ambient_temp_c represents the authoritative meteorological channel.
excluded_features_reason.pv_surplus_heater_elec_kw: Excluded to prevent downstream operational target leakage.

solar_model.selection_criterion: Lowest RMSE on 2022 chronological validation split (2023 Test kept untouched until final evaluation).

dryer_model.model_id: Model 2 — Biomass Dryer Thermal Demand Prediction
dryer_model.simulated_label_disclaimer: All Model 2 targets are deterministic outputs of the Phase 3 thermodynamic balance (compute_dryer_hourly_demand) coupled to real Settat 2020–2023 weather. They are explicitly labeled simulated_physics rather than experimental pilot-plant calorimeter measurements.
dryer_model.multi_feedstock_verdict: A single unified multi-feedstock Gradient Boosting Regressor is appropriate and recommended: across the 3 feedstocks, average 2023 Test RMSE is 0.858 kW_th vs. 0.771 kW_th for separate models, because physical drying demand shares common latent-evaporation and psychrometric laws captured cleanly via feedstock properties (Cp, bulk density) and one-hot identifiers.
